description: A fungal condition affecting the root system, common in overwatered houseplants.
symptoms: Yellowing leaves, mushy blackened roots, wilting despite moist soil.
causes: Caused by overwatering and poor drainage, thrives in waterlogged soil conditions.
solution: Reduce watering frequency, repot in well-draining soil, trim away affected roots.

description: A fungal or bacterial infection causing visible lesions on leaf surfaces.
symptoms: Brown or black spots on leaves, sometimes with yellow halos around them.
causes: Spreads in humid conditions with poor air circulation, often via water splashing on leaves.
solution: Remove affected leaves, avoid overhead watering, improve air circulation around the plant.

description: Small, soft-bodied insects covered in white cottony wax, found in leaf joints.
symptoms: Sticky residue on leaves, stunted growth, white cotton-like clusters visible.
causes: Thrive in warm indoor environments, often introduced via new infected plants.
solution: Wipe affected areas with alcohol-dipped cotton swab, apply neem oil, isolate infected plant.

description: Tiny arachnids that feed on plant sap, often invisible until infestation is heavy.
symptoms: Fine webbing on leaves, yellow speckled spots, leaves appear dusty or dry.
causes: Thrive in dry, warm indoor air, especially during low-humidity seasons.
solution: Increase humidity, spray leaves with water regularly, apply insecticidal soap if severe.

description: A bacterial infection causing dark, water-soaked spots that spread across leaves.
symptoms: Dark brown spots with yellow rings, leaves may drop prematurely.
causes: Spreads through water splash and high humidity, often worsened by overhead watering.
solution: Remove infected leaves, water at soil level only, ensure good air circulation.
